units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲和乳母觉得此事荒唐，卑鄙可厌。

en.t: Ukifune's mother and nurse thought the matter absurd, base, and disgusting.

units.source_text: 住在这里照管浮舟，也很乏味。

en.t: Staying here to look after Ukifune was also very dreary.

units.source_text: 母亲便写一封信给匂亲王夫人，信中说道：“无端相扰，乃放肆不恭之行。

en.t: Her mother therefore wrote a letter to Prince Niou's wife, saying, "To trouble you without cause is a bold and disrespectful act.

units.source_text: 因此多时以来，未敢任意致书。

en.t: For that reason, for a long time I have not dared to write to you at my own discretion.

units.source_text: 今者，小女浮舟欲回避凶神，拟暂时迁居他处。

en.t: Now my daughter Ukifune wishes to avoid an inauspicious spirit and plans to move elsewhere for a time.

units.source_text: 尊府隐蔽之处如有僻静之室可蒙赐借，不胜欣幸。

en.t: If there is a quiet room in some secluded part of your residence that you might lend us, I would be deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 我身愚陋无知，一手抚育此女，定多不周之处，因此痛苦之事甚多。

en.t: I am foolish and ignorant, and having raised this girl by myself, I must have failed her in many ways; because of this, there have been many painful matters.

units.source_text: 可仰仗者，惟有尊处而已。”

en.t: The only place I can rely on is yours alone."

units.source_text: 此信显然是和泪写成的，二女公子看了甚觉可怜。

en.t: The letter was plainly written through tears, and the Second Princess felt great pity when she read it.

units.source_text: 她想：“父亲生前不承认此人为女儿。

en.t: She thought, "While he was alive, Father did not acknowledge this person as his daughter.

units.source_text: 现在父姐皆故，只留我一人在世，我擅自认她为妹，是否应该呢？

en.t: Now that both Father and my sister are dead, and I alone remain in the world, is it right for me to acknowledge her as my younger sister on my own authority?

units.source_text: 但此人颠沛流离，艰难困苦，而我装作不知，置之不理，实在很不忍心。

en.t: But she has been wandering in hardship and distress, and it would be truly heartless for me to pretend not to know and leave her alone.

units.source_text: 并无特异事故而姐妹东分西散，在亡人恐亦名誉攸关吧？”

en.t: If sisters are scattered apart without any special reason, would that not also affect the honor of the deceased?"

units.source_text: 她心烦意乱，犹豫不决。

en.t: Her mind was troubled and confused, and she could not make up her mind.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲也曾向二女公子的侍女大辅君诉苦，因此大辅君对二女公子说：“中将君写这信来，必有不得已之苦衷。

en.t: Ukifune's mother had also poured out her troubles to the Second Princess's attendant, Taifu no Kimi, and so Taifu no Kimi said to the Second Princess, "Chujo no Kimi must have some unavoidable distress behind this letter.

units.source_text: 小姐复信不可冷淡，叫她难受。

en.t: My lady, your reply must not be cold and make her suffer.

units.source_text: 姐妹之中有庶出之人，乃世间常见之事。

en.t: It is common in the world for there to be a daughter of secondary birth among sisters.

units.source_text: 万不可过分疏远于她。”

en.t: You must by no means keep her too far at a distance."

units.source_text: 二女公子便复信道：“既蒙见嘱，舍间西面有僻静之室可以让出。

en.t: The Second Princess then wrote back, "Since you have asked me, there is a quiet room on the west side of my house that I can make available.

units.source_text: 惟设备十分简陋，倘蒙不嫌弃，即请暂时来住可也。”

en.t: The furnishings are very plain, but if you do not mind them, please come and stay there for a while."

units.source_text: 中将君得信不胜欣喜，就决定悄悄地带浮舟前往。

en.t: Chujo no Kimi was overjoyed to receive the reply and decided to take Ukifune there quietly.

units.source_text: 浮舟本来想亲近这位异母姐，此次婚事的变卦反而使她获得了机会，因此也很高兴。

en.t: Ukifune had already wanted to become close to this half sister, and the change in the marriage arrangements had instead given her the opportunity, so she too was happy.
